messages:
Ana Gomez: Heads-up — SI enablement plan for the new hardware + marketplace flow. I sketched a proposed runway for certification, sandbox labs, and the joint announcement timeline.
Mike Chan: +1, can you drop the checklist? I want to confirm dependencies with infra and marketing.
Ana Gomez: Sure — high level items: 1) SI curriculum (labs + evals), 2) HW validation matrix, 3) marketplace listing checklist, 4) certification badge & badge-criteria, 5) shipping/dev kits logistics, 6) kickoff cohort schedule.
Tara Liu: For HW validation: we should list min supported GPUs (H100, A100), driver/container versions, perf benchmarks (p99 < 120ms for 4k token demo) and recommended quant configs. Also list partner telemetry requirements.
Josh Patel: Agree on benchmarks. For the marketplace flow, we'll need SKU + pricing matrix and a clean terraform example so SI can reproduce. Suggest we add a small reference repo with a working deploy.
Ana Gomez: Draft marketplace command snippet:```bash
# create offer skeleton
redwood-cli marketplace create-offer --name "SI Partner Kit" --sku si-kit-2026 --region us-west-2
# attach pricing and docs
redwood-cli marketplace set-pricing --sku si-kit-2026 --tier reserved:monthly:5000
```
Kevin O'Neill: Can we make the reference repo a one-click demo in the marketplace listing? That helps SIs show customers a working flow. Also coordinate with cloud partner for marketplace QA window.
Mike Chan: Marketing asks: 6 weeks lead time for a co-branded announcement and customer story. We should lock the initial cohort dates to meet that.
Ana Gomez: Proposed timeline: Week 0: prereqs + lab kit shipouts; Week 1-2: cohort training (3 half-days), Week 3: evals + certification badges, Week 4: readiness sign-off + marketing assets final.
Tara Liu: For the lab kits: packing list: 1x NGC image, 1x private license key, 1x quickstart, 1x pytorch+triton container versions, 1x hardware checklist. Who owns shipping?
Josh Patel: Partners Ops can handle shipping if we feed them a CSV by EOD next Tuesday. I'll own the CSV template.
Ana Gomez: Roles: Ana (program lead), Mike (marketing / announcements), Tara (HW validation & labs), Josh (partner ops & reference repo), Kevin (marketplace integration).
Partners Bot: Reminder — submit marketplace offer for review by 1735001200 to meet partner QA window. :bell:
Kevin O'Neill: Quick question on certification tiers — proposal: Associate (passed basic eval), Certified Integrator (passed advanced lab + customer reference), Verified HW Integrator (passed hardware validation + signed agreement). Feedback?
Mike Chan: Sounds good. Add a badge SVG and short blurbs for the website. Marketing will produce case study template.
Ana Gomez: Risk items: delayed kit shipments, failing perf on older drivers, marketplace approval delays. Mitigation: extend internal rollout buffer by 2 weeks and schedule extra office hours.
Tara Liu: Can we set recurring enablement office hours? Weekly for 6 weeks, 1hr, rotating SMEs. I'll add to my calendar and invite the cohort leads.
Josh Patel: I'll post the CSV template and shipping SOP in the partners drive. Link when ready.
Ana Gomez: Next actions: 1) Mike — confirm announcement lead & assets deadline, 2) Tara — finalize validation matrix, 3) Josh — CSV + shipping SOP, 4) Kevin — prep marketplace sample + one-click demo, 5) Ana — schedule cohort and office hours. I'll follow up in 48h with an aligned timeline.
Mike Chan: @Ana please include marketing acceptance criteria (quote approvals, logo usage) in the follow-up.
Kevin O'Neill: Noted. Also ping the cloud marketplace PM for a dry-run slot next month.
Ana Gomez: Thanks team. Posting the draft timeline and checklist here — iterating now. :sparkles:
Partners Bot: Thread archived to partnerships/manuals after 7 days of inactivity.
